prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: C01-CH02-S09 伊芙拉断缰. One finished full-bleed opaque narrative game scene, native wide 16:9 landscape, preferably 1672×941. No border or text.
Input roles: Image 1 is approved scene style ONLY: broad chunky matte planes, economical dark contours, strong small-size silhouettes. Image 2 is Ivra's juvenile identity reference: young red dragon, amber eyes, gray belly plates, pale short horns, wings and long tail. The exact portrait is too cute for this moment: preserve juvenile anatomy and palette but use wary, exhausted expression, no smile or pet behavior. Image 3 supplies approved dragon material and color handling ONLY, not its larger adult proportions. Image 4 is the named woman Mirelle: preserve her brown hair, cream hood, dark navy robe and warm brass gravekeeper lantern; she is not an old bearded male. Image 5 shows the already approved broken bridle hardware: worn brown straps and separated bent silver ring pieces.
Story authority: On the north road through a rocky gorge, the Gray Banner has opened a church convoy cage. Engineers disconnect its four control nodes while Mirelle says the young dragon may leave, with no new owner. At the final release, Ivra itself bites and tears away its loosened iron neck ring and bridle, then pushes people away. It does NOT attack the convoy's humans or agree to be owned. Medicine wagons are allowed to continue to plague patients; grain wagons remain. This image depicts that single decisive instant of self-release, before Ivra flies away.
Composition: elevated three-quarter tactical fantasy view. Make the young red dragon the clear large central subject, about one-quarter of image width, crouched just outside the open cage wagon. Ivra's head is turned downward, its mouth visibly clamped on the dangling brown strap of its own now-broken neck restraint, pulling it free. One separated silver collar half hangs with the loose strap; the other half and broken chain links lie beside its foreclaw. Its neck is visibly free of a complete enclosing ring. Pale short horns, amber wary eyes, small stout juvenile body rather than infant toy or adult giant. Wings half-open and uneven with two small tears, subdued bruising and an abrasion on neck, no gore. Tail curls away from the people. Keep the head, mouth, torn strap and separated iron parts clear and unoccluded at 256×144.
Just behind the dragon to the upper-left is a squat heavy iron cage on a low wooden wagon, its front door unmistakably open and four severed attachment chains slack. An anonymous engineer crouches clear of Ivra near the last dismantled metal node with a wrench lowered. To the right of Ivra, separated by an empty arm's-length space, Mirelle stands with both hands open and low, not reaching toward it; her warm brass lantern is ON THE GROUND at her feet. She is calm, cautious, allowing escape, not casting a spell or commanding. The dragon and Mirelle stay within the center half of the wide frame. Background supports exactly three clear supply categories: a stationary wagon stacked with tan grain sacks; a covered medicine wagon rolling away along the open road with a visible crate of bottles; a small relic cargo wagon with one closed brass-and-gray ritual chest. Drivers are anonymous small figures, not named heroes. Low broad rock walls frame the clear sky and the escaping road. Sparse muted grass and broad dirt shapes, no city buildings.
Style: approved chunky matte tactical-fantasy cartoon, broad solid painted color planes, two or three shade values per form, thick clean outer outlines, simple stone faces and timber masses, controlled earth browns and stone gray with red Ivra, cream Mirelle hood, and tiny amber lantern. Strong clear silhouettes and ordinary daylight. No fine scale mosaic, microscopic bolts, grainy texture or busy background. Full authored wide scene preserved; the central self-release read should remain recognizable under a narrow center crop, but full composition comes first.
Constraints: Finished opaque scene. No typography, numbers, UI, decorative frame, logos, watermark or readable runes. No rider, saddle, harness held by a person, leash to a human, triumphant pet pose, smile, crown, adult giant dragon, fire-breath attack, blue magical beams, purple evil aura, gore or human controlling gesture. Do not copy the source legacy city plate, which is a known content mismatch and is archived separately. No other named hero appears.
